Subject: Short-term capacity for Q3 spike — urgent ask

Monica —

Quick context: Q3 product launch is moving up and we expect a ~55% burst in inference volume for 4–6 weeks starting mid-July. We need a short-term path to increase capacity with predictable pricing while keeping our contract co-term in September.

Questions:
- Can you provide a short-term top-up SKU (billed monthly) that covers ~60M tokens/day?
- Can we avoid a full uplift amendment (we want to avoid a full RMA right now) — is there a bridging credit or short-term invoice model?

Elena

From: monica.patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Short-term capacity for Q3 spike — urgent ask

Thanks Elena — we can absolutely support a short-term top-up and avoid a heavyweight contract amendment. I attached three options below (summary first, full breakdown in the XLSX):

Options (short summary)
1) Option A — Burst credits (no contract change)
   - Prepaid token credits usable for 6 weeks
   - 8% discount off list for bulk prepay
   - No co-term impact; credits consume first then regular billing resumes

2) Option B — Time-limited uplift (recommended)
   - Temporary capacity bump (adds dedicated share) for 6 weeks on a monthly invoice
   - 5% one-time credit applied to first month invoice if committed by 30 Jun
   - At co-term we will: (a) true-up used tokens and (b) offer a pro-rated conversion to annual committed capacity if you choose to annualize

3) Option C — Immediate partial commit + staged annualize
   - Small incremental commit for remainder of the term (lower burn rate) with staged step-up in September if you want permanent capacity
   - Larger volume discount (12%) if annualize in September

Key tradeoffs
- Credits (A) = fastest to execute, lowest operational overhead, but slightly higher unit cost.
- Time-limited uplift (B) = predictable performance, modest paperwork (amendment addendum), easy to revert.
- Partial commit (C) = best long-term economics but requires proc and PO sooner.

I attached the detailed pricing matrix and a usage snapshot we pulled from your account. If you’re available I can run through this on a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon.

Attachments:
- BrightBridge_MA_Pricing_Options_v1.xlsx (pricing + proforma invoices)
- q3-usage-snapshot.png (30-day usage heatmap)

Best,
Monica Patel
